name: build-system-adapter
description: The contract and adapter exports of the gauntlet's build_system axis harness Tools/gauntlet/harness/build-system.mjs and their Jet twin, the BuildSystem module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/BuildSystem.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver that prints one export's result: the contract issues of the manifest's cell, of a cell wrong in every field (a peer not required, a command that is not a list, an unbounded and a loose target, no samples) and of a missing cell; and the axis report the adapter projects from the receipt fixtures/fake-harness.mjs leaves in place of the harness's: a passing receipt (complete, a win, ready to publish, every cell's wall time per peer), a failing one (its failure and each cell that did not win are blockers, a cell without its Nix summary and the missing cells leave the report incomplete and unmeasured) and none at all (the harness's exit code blocks).
